entries.source_section_or_line: the whole framing: Sec 21.4 / Sec 17.3 applied to all three symbols
entries.old_statement: the critical-queue-position framework of Sec 21.4 / Sec 17.3 was applied to BTC, ETH and SOL alike, justified by the measured fact that the spread is one tick on all three
entries.corrected_statement: Sec 17.3 is titled LARGE-TICK STOCKS and Chapter 17 contains a separate section for the other regime -- Sec 17.2, INVENTORY CONTROL FOR SMALL-TICK STOCKS -- which this lane never opened. BTC and ETH are its small-tick symbols. The spread-equals-one-tick justification licenses Sec 21.4's SETUP, not the choice of economic framework: for small-tick names the book's object is inventory control with no queue position in it at all. NOTHING NUMERICAL IS WITHDRAWN -- the arithmetic core (s/2 - fee = -1.99 / -1.97 / -1.34 before any adverse selection) is framework-free, and Sec 17.2's slow limit E[G]/v0T = s/2 - R_inf reproduces this lane's phi -> 0 row in structure and sign. What is corrected is the FRAMING: the phi-sweep answered a large-tick question on two small-tick instruments, and its informative endpoint was the small-tick answer all along.
